_comment: These are the only values fetch_ml.py sends to the API. They are kept in config
rather than in code because category ids and attribute ids are MercadoLibre's to
change, not ours, and you should be able to correct them without editing Python.
category: MLA1459 is Inmuebles (real estate) on site MLA (Argentina).
If a category id is wrong the API returns zero results rather than failing loudly,
so run `python3 fetch_ml.py --probe` after changing anything here.
attribute_map: MercadoLibre returns facts as an `attributes` array of
{id, value_name, value_struct}. We read ONLY the ids listed here. An id that is
absent from a listing yields null, which the pipeline renders as 'Not verified.'
We never infer a missing attribute from the free-text description.
user_agent: san-isidro-house-hunter/1.0 (personal single-family home search; low volume; contact via repo)
